title: Odd-degree majority coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be odd, let $k$ be odd, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates in $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$ with $|S|=k$. The Fourier coefficient of majority at $S$ is $(-1)^{(k-1)/2}\binom{(n-1)/2}{(k-1)/2}\big/\binom{n-1}{k-1}\;\cdot\;2\binom{n-1}{(n-1)/2}/2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
